lines.en: label ayanespring1:
Ami leaves the room and I’m left alone again.
lines.zh: Ami 离开房间，我又一次独自留了下来。

lines.en: I can hear the sounds of seven different locks being closed and, if I hadn’t already realized just how desperately she’s been trying to keep me safe, I’d know it now for sure.
lines.zh: 我能听见七把不同的锁被逐一锁上的声音；如果我之前还没意识到她有多么拼命地在保护我，那现在我算是彻底确定了。

lines.en: I don’t hear her call Ayane. And I’m not sure I’d even want to as I’m positive the call would be laced with countless clauses and concerns Ami has.
lines.zh: 我没听见她给 Ayane 打电话。我也不确定自己想不想听见——因为我敢肯定，那通电话里会塞满 Ami 数不清的条件和担忧。

lines.en: I just sit there, on a bed drenched in sweat, and wonder what will happen next.
lines.zh: 我只是坐在那里，坐在一张被汗水浸透的床上，想着接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: I wonder what she’ll say when she sees me. Or if she even {i}will{/i} see me if she’s not open to adhering to whatever my niece’s demands are.
lines.zh: 我在想，她看到我的时候会说些什么。或者说，如果她不愿意服从我侄女提出的那些要求，她到底还{i}能不能{/i}见到我。

lines.en: She probably will be.
lines.zh: 她大概会愿意的。

lines.en: She’s probably desperate by now.
lines.zh: 她现在大概已经绝望了。

lines.en: I know this to be true because that’s the case for me. And while Ayane might be able to put on a brave face in my times of peril, there are limits to just how brave that face can be.
lines.zh: 我之所以知道这是真的，是因为我自己就是如此。虽然 Ayane 也许能在我遭遇危难时装出一张勇敢的脸，但那张脸究竟能有多勇敢，是有极限的。

lines.en: She’s only human, after all.
lines.zh: 她毕竟只是个人。

lines.en: She’s just a girl, after all.
lines.zh: 她毕竟只是个女孩。

lines.en: If the fraying of the ropes that hold me up does not cease within the coming days, I will fall for the rest of my life. So why should I abstain from reaching out for someone who can cover it in knots?
lines.zh: 如果吊着我的那些绳索继续磨损、不在接下来的日子里停下，我这一生都会坠落下去。那么，我为什么要克制自己，不去伸手抓住一个能把它打成结的人？

lines.en: I owe her the chance to save my life after all she’s done for me. And I’m sure that sounds selfish. The things I say seldom don’t.
lines.zh: 在她为我做了这一切之后，我欠她一个救我一命的机会。而我确信这听起来很自私。我说出口的话，很少有不自私的。

lines.en: But when she fails, and she likely will, I hope she won’t hate herself for being incapable of cushioning the blow.
lines.zh: 但当她失败的时候——她很可能会失败——我希望她不要因为无力缓冲这一击而恨自己。

lines.en: Because right now, I feel as if I could crack my head on anything.
lines.zh: 因为现在，我觉得自己的脑袋随便撞在什么上面都能裂开。

lines.en: I feel as if it’s egg time.
lines.zh: 我觉得，现在是鸡蛋时间了。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback1
: Are you sure it’s okay? I can really go in?
lines.zh: : 你确定真的可以吗？我真的能进去？

lines.en: : Actually, Ayane, I’m {i}not{/i} sure. This obviously wasn’t my idea. {i}I{/i} want you as far away from my house and my uncle as humanly possible.
lines.zh: : 说真的，Ayane，我{i}不{/i}确定。这显然不是我的主意。{i}我{/i}想让你离我家、离我叔叔越远越好。

lines.en: : But he’s weak right now...and I’m not going to tell him he can’t have something when I know he truly wants it. And, for some reason, he wants {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但他现在很虚弱……而当我知道他真的想要什么的时候，我是不会告诉他不能拥有的。而且，不知为什么，他想要的是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : He asked for me specifically? Not, like...you know...{i}anyone else?{/i}
lines.zh: : 他特意指名要我？不是……比如说……{i}别的任何人{/i}？

lines.en: : He’s been calling a different name in his sleep. But since the two of you have gotten so {i}close{/i} behind my back, I assume you already know who that is. Correct?
lines.zh: : 他睡着的时候一直喊着另一个名字。不过既然你们两个背着我变得这么{i}亲近{/i}，我猜你已经知道那是谁了。对吧？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback2
: Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : If you do {i}anything{/i} to hurt him while you’re in there, you will never see either one of us again. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 如果你在里面做了{i}任何{/i}伤害他的事，你就再也见不到我们两个中的任何一个了。明白吗？

lines.en: : Ami, I’ve been telling you this whole time — I have no intention of hurting him.
lines.zh: : Ami，我从头到尾都在跟你说——我根本没有打算伤害他。

lines.en: : See, I don’t really care about your {i}intentions.{/i} Even if you hurt him on {i}accident,{/i} you will never see either one of us again. {i}Do you understand?{/i}
lines.zh: : 听着，我不在乎你的{i}意图{/i}。就算你只是{i}不小心{/i}伤到了他，你也再也见不到我们两个中的任何一个了。{i}明白吗{/i}？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback3
: Yes. I understand. And thank you, Ami. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 是。我明白。谢谢你，Ami。我是真心的。

lines.en: : I really, really mean it.
lines.zh: : 我真的、真的是真心的。

lines.en: : We’ve known each other a long time, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们认识很久了吧？

lines.en: : We have.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : Do you love me, Ayane? Like...really {i}really{/i} love me?
lines.zh: : 你爱我吗，Ayane？就是……真的{i}真的{/i}很爱我的那种？

lines.en: : I do.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback4
: {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I’ve been getting on your nerves a lot lately, haven’t I? Between keeping Sensei here...and ditching you in the woods...and forcing myself into your “private affairs...”
lines.zh: : 我最近老是惹你心烦吧？比如说把 Sensei 留在这儿……在树林里把你甩掉……硬挤进你的“私人事务”……

lines.en: : Even the way I’ve looked at you...{i}argued{/i} with you. Despite all of that “Waaaah, my friends are leaving me” crap, what I {i}really{/i} wanted was some peace and quiet.
lines.zh: : 还有我看你的方式……跟你{i}吵架{/i}的方式。别看我嘴上说的全是“哇啊啊，我的朋友们都要离开我了”那套废话，我{i}真正{/i}想要的其实只是一点清净。

lines.en: : I don’t care if you hate me. I don’t care if {i}anyone{/i} hates me. The only person who will ever {i}really{/i} matter to me is Sensei. And I would trade {i}your{/i} happiness for {i}his{/i} complacency in a heartbeat.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎你恨不恨我。我不在乎{i}任何人{/i}恨不恨我。这世上唯一对我{i}真正{/i}重要的人只有 Sensei。我可以在一瞬间之内，拿{i}你的{/i}幸福去换{i}他的{/i}安宁。

lines.en: : Why are you telling me this?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么要跟我说这些？……

lines.en: : Because, for whatever reason, you’ve stopped falling for it. And I trust Sensei enough to trust that {i}you{/i} will not go out of your way to “rescue” him from this house. He does not need to be {i}rescued.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为不知为什么，你已经不吃这一套了。而我足够信任 Sensei，所以我相信{i}你{/i}不会特意来把他从这栋房子里“救”出去。他不需要被{i}救{/i}。

lines.en: : Do I make myself clear, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 我说得够清楚了吗，Ayane？

lines.en: : If Sensei goes back to school like none of this ever happened, it will ruin everything. {i}Everything.{/i} And even if I know what’s best for him, I can’t {i}keep{/i} him here if he doesn’t want to {i}be{/i} here.
lines.zh: : 如果 Sensei 就这么回到学校去，装作这一切从没发生过，那会毁掉一切。{i}一切{/i}。而且，就算我知道什么对他最好，只要他自己不想{i}待在{/i}这儿，我也{i}留不住{/i}他。

lines.en: : What do you mean by “like none of this ever happened?” And “it will ruin everything?” Because I’m pretty sure you have no idea what even {i}happened{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: : “装作这一切从没发生过”是什么意思？“会毁掉一切”又是什么意思？因为我敢肯定，你连到底{i}发生{/i}了什么都不清楚。

lines.en: : And that’s something you {i}do{/i} know?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}就{/i}清楚？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback5
: Yes! I tried to tell you in the karaoke booth! But you were so focused on getting Sensei back home that you wouldn’t listen to what-
lines.zh: : 是啊！我在卡拉 OK 包厢里就想告诉你了！可你只顾着把 Sensei 弄回家，根本不肯听我说什么——

lines.en: : I don’t care about {i}what.{/i} I care about {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不在乎“{i}什么{/i}”。我在乎的是“{i}为什么{/i}”。

lines.en: : {i}Why{/i} do you know what’s wrong, Ayane? This shouldn’t involve you.
lines.zh: : 你{i}为什么{/i}会知道出了什么事，Ayane？这不该把你卷进来。

lines.en: : You should be back at the dorms, goofing around and playing games with Sana. Or practicing karate at the dojo. Or...getting kicked out of various local businesses or whatever it is you’re {i}supposed{/i} to do.
lines.zh: : 你该待在宿舍里，跟 Sana 一起瞎闹、打游戏。或者在道场里练空手道。或者……被本地的各种店铺赶出来，或者随便你{i}该{/i}干的什么事。

lines.en: : But you’re not. You’re {i}here.{/i} And I’m having a little trouble understanding how that could possibly be a good thing for {i}any{/i} of us or {i}why{/i} it’s even happening in the first place.
lines.zh: : 但你没有。你在{i}这里{/i}。而我有点搞不懂，这对我们{i}任何{/i}人来说怎么可能是件好事，更搞不懂它{i}为什么{/i}会发生。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback6
: I don’t care about what’s “good” or what I’m “supposed” to be doing anymore. I’m just worried about Sensei. And I know you can relate to that, Ami. If {i}anyone{/i} can relate to that, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 我已经不在乎什么“好”、什么我“该”做什么了。我只是担心 Sensei。而我知道你能理解这一点，Ami。如果{i}有人{/i}能理解，那就是你。

lines.en: : Stop comparing your “love” for him to mine. It’s going to make me sick.
lines.zh: : 别再把你对他的“爱”和我的相提并论。那会让我恶心。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : You have ten minutes. Go in there, say what is you have to say, listen to whatever it is {i}Sensei{/i} has to say...then leave.
lines.zh: : 你有十分钟。进去，把你想说的说完，听听 {i}Sensei{/i} 要说什么……然后离开。

lines.en: : Go back to your normal routine. Find someone else to burden with your undying affection. Just leave my uncle out of it.
lines.zh: : 回到你正常的日常里去。去找别人承受你那份永恒的爱吧。别把我叔叔扯进来。

lines.en: : You two were never meant to be.
lines.zh: : 你们两个本来就不该在一起。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback7
: You know...I feel really bad for you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我真的很同情你，Ami。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re kind of supposed to.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你本来就该同情我。

lines.en: : Do you want to know why, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，你想知道为什么吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I still have to make breakfast since the first dish I made wound up all over the floor.
lines.zh: : 不太想。我还得去做早餐呢，毕竟我做的第一盘菜全洒在地上了。

lines.en: : It’s because you think you understand what love is, but I’m not sure you’ve actually {i}felt{/i} it even once in your life.
lines.zh: : 因为你以为自己懂什么是爱，但我不确定你这辈子是不是真的{i}感受过{/i}哪怕一次。

lines.en: : Cute. How long have you been holding onto that line for?
lines.zh: : 真可爱。这句话你憋了多久了？

lines.en: : Depends. How long have you been holding onto literally everything you’ve said to me today?
lines.zh: : 看情况。那你今天对我说的每一句话，又憋了多久？

lines.en: scene black
: You don’t want to know.
lines.zh: : 你不会想知道的。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback8
It’s hard to explain the look that was on Ayane’s face when she first walked into the room, but I think I’d describe it as somewhere between pity, gratefulness, and frustration.
lines.zh: Ayane 刚走进房间时脸上的表情很难形容，但我想我会把它描述成介于怜悯、感激和挫败之间的某种东西。

lines.en: I’m not sure if she was expecting me to look a little more “broken” than I currently am given just how long I’ve been away, but it took all of three seconds to make me feel as if I disappointed her.
lines.zh: 我不确定她是不是以为，在我离开了这么久之后，我看上去会比现在更“破碎”一些，但她只花了三秒钟，就让我觉得自己辜负了她。

lines.en: Besides, what’s on the outside very rarely exemplifies the way my heart moves.
lines.zh: 再者说，外表很少能代表我内心的运转方式。

lines.en: Right now, there are a million different thoughts swirling through my head. And if you’ve ever lost anyone before, I’m sure you know that none of them are good.
lines.zh: 此刻，有一百万种不同的念头在我脑海里翻腾。如果你曾经失去过什么人，我敢肯定你知道，它们没有一个是好的。

lines.en: Finding a way to shelve them for the sake of communicating with someone else, especially someone who reminds you of that person, isn’t easy.
lines.zh: 为了能和另一个人交流而把它们暂时搁置——尤其当那个人会让你想起那个人的时候——绝不是件容易的事。

lines.en: But she knows I’m alive, at least. And that’s more than everyone else has gotten as of late.
lines.zh: 但至少，她知道我还活着。而这已经比最近其他所有人得到的都要多了。

lines.en: Where do we begin, though? What words can I say to break the two month silence in a way suitable to her perception of me as a human being?
lines.zh: 不过，该从哪里开始呢？我该说些什么话，才能打破这两个月的沉默，又不破坏她对我这个人的看法？

lines.en: Is this the part where I attempt to make a joke and fail miserably? Should I apologize for my absence? Would it be normal to say something mildly sexual? Just wrap my arm around her and tell her I love her?
lines.zh: 现在是不是该讲个笑话、然后惨败收场？我该为自己的缺席道歉吗？说点略带性意味的话算不算正常？还是干脆一把搂住她，告诉她我爱她？

lines.en: What am I like? Who am I supposed to be? The answers to such questions used to only be slightly more difficult than breathing. But now, it’s like I’m struggling with both.
lines.zh: 我是什么样的人？我该成为什么样的人？这些问题的答案，过去只比呼吸稍微难那么一点。可现在，我好像连呼吸都成问题。

lines.en: And I can’t even retreat to the self-soothing plea that “I want to go home” because I’m already here.
lines.zh: 而我甚至连“我想回家”这句自我安慰的祈求都退不回去了，因为我已经在家了。

lines.en: : Sensei...you don’t have to talk. I’m sure it’s...not exactly easy after all you’ve been through.
lines.zh: : Sensei……你不用说话。我敢肯定，在经历了这一切之后，那……并不容易。

lines.en: : I can talk. But you’re right...it’s not easy.
lines.zh: : 我能说话。不过你说得对……不容易。

lines.en: : I can barely even move my limbs right now. And between that and my complete inability to remember how to converse with another person, it’s like I’m the world’s most miserable mannequin.
lines.zh: : 我现在连四肢都几乎动不了。再加上我完全想不起来该怎么跟人交谈，我就像全世界最惨的人体模特。

lines.en: : Staying in bed for two months will do that to a person...
lines.zh: : 在床上躺上两个月，是会变成这样的……

lines.en: : I imagine you’ll be feeling pretty terrible for at least another few weeks. But...at least you’re conscious? I think? Unless...you’ve {i}been{/i} conscious this whole time?
lines.zh: : 我想，接下来的至少几周里你都会感觉很糟糕。不过……至少你还清醒着？我猜？除非……你其实{i}一直{/i}都是清醒的？

lines.en: : I don’t...really know what’s been going on in here, to be honest. Nobody does. Ami’s kept you guarded like the vaults of Fort Knox.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我……不太清楚这里面到底发生了什么。没人清楚。Ami 把你守得像诺克斯堡的金库一样。

lines.en: : Then kudos to Uta and Io for managing to break in last night.
lines.zh: : 那 Uta 和 Io 昨晚能闯进来，倒还真值得表扬。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback9
: Oh, is {i}that{/i} what happened to the window? I was wondering what the boards were all about.
lines.zh: : 哦，窗户原来是{i}这么{/i}坏的啊？我还纳闷那些木板是怎么回事呢。

lines.en: : Yeah. According to Ami, they were here. I don’t really know any of the details, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊。据 Ami 说，她们来过。不过细节我一点也不清楚。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback10
: I guess that explains why they weren’t at the party, then. I’m glad it was that and not them just...growing distant from everybody else.
lines.zh: : 那大概就能解释她们为什么没去派对了。我很庆幸是这个原因，而不是她们就这么……和大家渐渐疏远了。

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say Io’s already not like that, but...yeah...
lines.zh: : 我可不是说 Io 本来就不那样，不过……是啊……

lines.en: : I’m...happy you’re okay. Even {i}if{/i} okay doesn’t really mean “okay” in this context.
lines.zh: : 我……很高兴你没事。{i}就算{/i}在这个语境下，“没事”其实也算不上“没事”。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m saying is I’m just happy to see you again. Even if the situation itself is kind of...the worst thing that could have possibly happened.
lines.zh: : 我想我要说的是，能再见到你我很高兴。就算这状况本身算是……可能发生的最糟的事。

lines.en: : It could have been worse. You could be gone too.
lines.zh: : 本来可能更糟的。你也可能不在了。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback11
: Without spending too much time whining about {i}my{/i} problems, the last couple months have made me feel like that wouldn’t have changed much.
lines.zh: : 不花太多时间抱怨{i}我的{/i}破事的话，这两个月让我觉得，就算我不在了，也没什么两样。

lines.en: : Has it been hard? Being alone this whole time, I mean. Because at least I’ve had Ami. Even if I haven’t really been {i}present{/i} at all within that time.
lines.zh: : 很艰难吧？我是说，这一整段时间都孤单一人。因为至少我还有 Ami。虽然那段时间里我其实根本没真正“{i}在场{/i}”过。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback12
: Well...here’s where things get interesting. Because I {i}haven’t{/i} been alone. Makoto made it to the rooftop that night as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这就是有意思的地方了。因为我{i}并不{/i}孤单。那天晚上 Makoto 也上了天台。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback13
: Makoto {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : Makoto {i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Yeah...so that’s a new development. A development I obviously don’t blame you for not remembering since you were kind of catatonic when the reset happened.
lines.zh: : 是啊……所以这是个新情况。一个我显然不会怪你记不得的新情况，毕竟重置发生的时候你基本上处于紧张性木僵的状态。

lines.en: : Then...who actually {i}started{/i} the reset? It had to be you, right?
lines.zh: : 那么……到底是谁{i}启动{/i}了重置？肯定是你吧？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback14
: Uhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃嗯嗯……

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s just go with that.
lines.zh: : 对。就这么定吧。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene ayanecameback15
: Anyway...Maya’s still here too. It’s just...you know...her {i}memories{/i} that...
lines.zh: : 总之……Maya 也还在。只是……你知道的……是她的{i}记忆{/i}……

lines.en: : What’s she like? Without being jaded by centuries of meaningless time travel?
lines.zh: : 她现在是什么样？在被几百年的无意义时间旅行磨得愤世嫉俗之前？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback16
: Honestly...not that different.
lines.zh: : 老实说……没多大区别。

lines.en: : Like, she kind of blends in with everyone else a little better since she’s not so busy trying to figure out the secrets of the universe all the time.
lines.zh: : 比如说，她跟其他人融合得稍微好一点了，因为她不用总忙着去破解宇宙的秘密。

lines.en: : But other than that, she’s just sort of...sassier. But in a typical Maya sort of way.
lines.zh: : 但除此之外，她只是变得……更爱顶嘴了一点。不过是典型的 Maya 式顶嘴。

lines.en: : Has she said anything about me?
lines.zh: : 她有说起过我吗？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback17
: Just...the same kind of stuff she always says when other people are around. Like how you’re gross and...a pervert and...you know. Stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 只是……跟别人在场时她常说的那套。比如你很恶心……是个变态……你知道的。就那种。

lines.en: : Well, at least that hasn’t changed.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少这个没变。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: scene ayanecameback18
: I...talked to Chika too. Last night.
lines.zh: : 我……也跟 Chika 谈过了。昨晚。

lines.en: : Oh, good. I can only imagine how she’s handling this.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。我能想象她是怎么熬过来的。

lines.en: : Yeah...she hasn’t been doing so great. She’s cutting class almost every day now that you’re not around anymore...And, weirdly enough, Yumi’s been showing up {i}more.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊……她过得不太好。你不在了之后，她几乎天天逃课……而且奇怪的是，Yumi 倒来得{i}勤{/i}了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that also makes sense.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这也说得通。

lines.en: : But, uhh...
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……

lines.en: scene ayanecameback19
: You know, Chika had a really good idea. And she called me last night to talk about it since she figured I’d be the easiest way to infiltrate your house.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Chika 有个很好的主意。她昨晚打电话跟我说了，因为她觉得我是潜进你家最省事的途径。

lines.en: : Little did she know, I had no clue when I’d even be able to {i}do{/i} that until just a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 她不知道的是，直到不久之前，我连自己什么时候能{i}办到{/i}都毫无头绪。

lines.en: : But she thought it might be good for you if all of us, like...put a card together for you. To tell you that we’re all waiting for you to come back and stuff.
lines.zh: : 但她觉得，如果我们所有人……比如说，一起给你做张卡片，对你可能会有好处。好告诉你我们都在等你回来之类的。

lines.en: : And you managed to collect everyone’s signature in just one night?
lines.zh: : 而你一晚上就集齐了所有人的签名？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback20
: Um...no.
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有。

lines.en: : See, she didn’t call me until it was really late and...I kind of just took her idea and ran with it. So, this is a card. Yeah. But it’s...from me. I didn’t get anyone else’s signature.
lines.zh: : 是这样的，她打电话给我时已经很晚了，而我……基本上是拿走了她的点子就自己干了起来。所以，这是一张卡片。没错。但它是……我一个人写的。我没拿到别人的签名。

lines.en: : Then...can I read it now? Or do you want me to wait until you’re gone?
lines.zh: : 那么……我现在能看吗？还是要等你走了再看？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback21
: You can read it now, but...I’m sorry in advance if it seems frantic or rushed or anything like that. It’s...weirdly difficult putting your feelings down on paper when you have so many of them.
lines.zh: : 你现在就能看，不过……如果它看起来很仓促、很赶，或者别的什么，我先道个歉。当你有太多感情的时候，要把它们写在纸上，奇怪地困难。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback22
: You’d think after all the ones I wrote for my mom that I’d be better at this by now, but...nope. Still suck.
lines.zh: : 你会以为，在给我妈写了那么多封之后，我现在该更擅长这个了，但……没有。还是烂透了。

lines.en: : I should have just written you an essay instead.
lines.zh: : 我真该干脆给你写一篇作文的。

lines.en: : You’ve been writing letters to your mom?
lines.zh: : 你一直在给你妈妈写信？

lines.en: scene ayanecameback23
: I keep them in a box underneath my bed in case I ever find out where she lives now. I’ve got...probably hundreds down there.
lines.zh: : 我把它们收在我床底下的一个盒子里，万一哪天我查到她现在住在哪儿呢。下面大概有……几百封了吧。

lines.en: : And I know I’ll be holding onto them for the rest of my life, but...miracles happen sometimes. And I’m dumb enough to keep believing in them.
lines.zh: : 我知道自己会一辈子留着它们，不过……奇迹有时候是会发生的。而我蠢到愿意一直相信下去。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback24
: I shouldn’t be greedy, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不该贪心。

lines.en: : Like, who would I be to ask for a second miracle with the first one sitting right beside me?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，第一个奇迹就坐在我旁边，我算什么人，还敢奢求第二个？

lines.en: : Bold move to flirt with me while Ami is very likely right outside the door.
lines.zh: : 在 Ami 很可能就在门外的情况下跟我调情，胆子挺大啊。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback25
: Oh, she’s definitely right outside the door. And she gave me a real earful when I first came in. But I’ve been keeping my voice low enough that she won’t be able to hear it.
lines.zh: : 哦，她确实就在门外。我刚进来的时候被她好一顿数落。不过我一直压低了声音，她听不见的。

lines.en: : Either way, though...I’m not worried about her.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样……我不担心她。

lines.en: : Ami loves you, Sensei. In a way that...I don’t think any of us will ever understand. I just don’t think she understands how crazy that can make her look at times.
lines.zh: : Ami 爱你，Sensei。那种方式……我觉得我们谁都不会懂。我只是觉得，她不明白那有时会让她看起来有多疯狂。

lines.en: : Like, she’s been even worse than normal when it comes to you lately. {i}A lot{/i} worse. To the point where some of the girls have thought about reporting your case to the police.
lines.zh: : 比如，最近她对你的态度比平时还要过分得多。过分{i}太多{/i}了。严重到有些女生想过要把你的事报警。

lines.en: : I think some might have even gone through with it. Especially since Uta and Io were willing to go as far as breaking into your house. A little report seems like nothing by comparison.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有些人可能真的报了。尤其是 Uta 和 Io 连闯进你家都愿意干，相比之下，一份小小的报案似乎不算什么。

lines.en: : I guess nothing ever came of it, though, if Ami’s still got you locked up after all this time.
lines.zh: : 不过看样子什么也没发生，毕竟过了这么久，Ami 还把你锁着。

lines.en: : Either that or she killed and buried all of the police who were brave enough to come knocking on the door.
lines.zh: : 要么就是，她把所有敢来敲门的警察都杀了埋了。

lines.en: : Hahah...yeah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: scene black
: Let’s maybe not joke about that.
lines.zh: : 这个我们还是别拿来开玩笑了。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback26
Ayane’s letter is just as frantic and rushed as she said it might be. But it’s honest in the same way Niki’s old letters were when Noriko handed a box of them to me a few Christmases ago.
lines.zh: Ayane 的信正如她说的那样仓促、赶工。但它和 Niki 那些旧信一样诚实——就是几个圣诞节前 Noriko 递给我一盒的那种信。

lines.en: Granted, this one is far less insane- and it focuses primarily on recapping everything that’s happened while I’ve been over here in agony.
lines.zh: 虽说这封远没有那么疯狂——它主要集中回顾了我在这边痛苦挣扎的这段时间里发生的一切。

lines.en: Imani and Wakana are losing it. Rin and Otoha broke up. Makoto’s joined the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad and Sana’s been-
lines.zh: Imani 和 Wakana 快崩溃了。Rin 和 Otoha 分手了。Makoto 加入了天台末日小队，而 Sana 一直——

lines.en: scene sanaisabadgirl21
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit36
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit40
scene ayanecameback26
Sana’s been acting differently...
lines.zh: Sana 一直表现得很不一样……

lines.en: There are other things in here too. Like how much she misses me or how different school is now that she’s actually required to work again.
lines.zh: 信里还写了别的事。比如她有多想我，比如现在她真的被要求回去工作之后，学校变了多少。

lines.en: She likes it. It keeps her busy so she’s not stuck thinking about me all the time. But of course, those thoughts pick back up at night.
lines.zh: 她喜欢这样。忙碌让她不至于整天困在想我的念头里。但当然，到了夜里，那些念头又会卷土重来。

lines.en: She’s been crying a lot. The letter doesn’t say that, but there’s a smudge near the bottom left corner of the page that I’m pretty sure is a tear drop.
lines.zh: 她哭了很多次。信里没写，但纸页左下角有一块晕开的痕迹，我敢肯定那是一滴眼泪。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback27
I put my arm around her. But I do it because I want to, not because I want to comfort her.
lines.zh: 我用手臂环住她。但我这么做是因为我想这么做，不是因为我想安慰她。

lines.en: And for a brief moment in time, I forget just why I’m here in the first place.
lines.zh: 而有那么一瞬间，我忘了自己究竟为什么在这里。

lines.en: I forget the grief and the loss and the sensation of connecting with someone who seemed so out of reach for so, so long.
lines.zh: 我忘了悲伤，忘了失去，忘了与一个似乎那么久、那么久都遥不可及的人重新相连的感觉。

lines.en: But it comes back near the end of the letter when she talks about {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 但到了信的结尾，当她谈起 {i}Maya{/i} 的时候，一切又回来了。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback28
{i}I watched Maya struggle with her collar after school the other day. The one with the bell she always wears.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}前几天放学后，我看着 Maya 跟她的项圈较劲。就是她一直戴着的那条带铃铛的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Were you the one who bought that for her? Was it so you could always hear her coming? Did the sound of walking beside her cheer you up like it always does for me?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那是你买给她的吗？是为了让你总能听见她走来吗？走在她身边时那铃声让你心情变好，就像它一直对我做的那样吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Regardless of the reason, I watched her struggle. She couldn’t get the clasp to work and she slammed it down on the table.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不管原因是什么，我看着她挣扎。她怎么也扣不上那个扣子，然后把它重重砸在桌上。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For a moment, it looked like she was going to cry. But she held her breath, tried again, and eventually got the clasp to work.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有那么一瞬间，她看起来快哭了。但她屏住呼吸，又试了一次，最后总算把扣子扣上了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’m pretty sure she misses you. Even if she won’t say it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我敢肯定她想你。就算她不肯说。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please, come back to us.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}求你了，回到我们身边吧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}求你了。{/i}

lines.en: : Thank you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Ayane。

lines.en: : You don’t have to thank me. In fact, I’d prefer if you didn’t. Things have been so hectic lately that I didn’t even remember to get you a real present for Christmas.
lines.zh: : 你不用谢我。事实上，我更希望你别谢。最近太乱了，我连一份像样的圣诞礼物都忘了给你准备。

lines.en: : This is more than enough. And way more than I’ve ever gotten you for any occasion.
lines.zh: : 这已经足够了。而且比我送过你的任何东西都多得多。

lines.en: : You’re right. You should buy me presents more often.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。你该多给我买点礼物。

lines.en: : I should.
lines.zh: : 是该。

lines.en: : You should say more nice things to me and spend more time with me and tell me you love me more often and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你该多对我说些好听的话，多陪陪我，多告诉我说你爱我什么的。

lines.en: : I should.
lines.zh: : 是该。

lines.en: : You should marry me.
lines.zh: : 你该娶我。

lines.en: : I should.
lines.zh: : 是该。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback29
scene ayanecameback30
: Uhh...
: Saying it like that kind of makes it sound like you’re actually...considering it?
lines.zh: : 你这么说我怎么听着像是你真的……在考虑这件事？

lines.en: : Does it? Interesting.
lines.zh: : 是吗？有意思。

lines.en: : {i}Interesting?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有意思？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s risky, though. Makoto already has my signature on a marriage registration and I’m pretty sure submitting both might cause some problems.
lines.zh: : 不过有风险。Makoto 已经在一张结婚登记表上有我的签名了，我敢肯定两份一起提交会出点问题。

lines.en: : Why does Makoto have your signature on a wedding registration, exactly?
lines.zh: : 为什么 Makoto 的结婚登记表上会有你的签名，确切地说？

lines.en: : It was an accident.
lines.zh: : 那是个意外。

lines.en: : And I’m going to guess your penis also wound up inside of her after the two of you slipped on a banana peel?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，你们两个踩到香蕉皮滑倒之后，你的阴茎也刚好滑进她身体里了？

lines.en: : It was a large banana. You’re familiar with them. You know how it works.
lines.zh: : 那是一根很大的香蕉。你对它们很熟。你知道是怎么回事。

lines.en: : Sensei...do you really-
lines.zh: : Sensei……你真的——

lines.en: : Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ayane。

lines.en: scene ayanecameback31
: What? What is it?
lines.zh: : 什么？什么事？

lines.en: scene black
: I need your help talking to Ami.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮我跟 Ami 谈。

$ ayane_love += 10

lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升了 10 点！{/i}
